newsitem.title: POLAND: Creditanstalt to expand in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt to expand in Poland.

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt Bankverein which lost a race to buy the Polish Investment Bank SA (PBI) to a Polish bank, said on Saturday it would look for new acquisition opportunities in Poland.

"We have been informed about... the fact that Kredyt bank won the tender to buy shares in the Polish Investment Bank... Creditanstalt accepts this decision with regret," that bank said in a statement.
"Developing its own bank, Creditanstalt will actively observe the appearance of new acquisition opportunities," the statement said.

On Friday, Kredyt bank and the National Bank of Poland signed an agreement for Kredyt's purchase of all of PBI, previously controlled by the central bank, and 92.36 percent of the ailing Prosper Bank SA for 205 million zlotys and investment guarantees.
The central bank's deputy head Witold Kozinski said Kredyt had presented a better offer than the Austrian bank.
Last month, the Polish unit of Creditanstalt said it wanted to double the number of its branches in Poland to 15 and offer new products. Creditanstalt launched its Polish subsidiary in 1991.
